title: Hinglish and Tanglish Transliterated Bank KYC Fraud
text: Sir aapka SBI bank account block ho jayega aaj raat tak. Jaldi se apna pan card update kare aur otp share kare nahi toh khata band ho jayega. Click kare: http://bit.ly/sbi-pan-update
description: Transliterated Hinglish phishing SMS warning user about account closure, demanding OTP share, and including bit.ly link.
